blocks.text: Jab tay ho jaye ke masla solvable hai, to agla sawal us ki computational complexity ka hota hai, yani woh kitni efficiency se hal ho sakta hai. Hal karne ke liye zaroori wasail (waqt aur space yani memory) ki bunyad par masail ko tractable ya intractable kaha jata hai.

Tractable Problems (qabil-e-intezam masail): masla tractable hai agar woh polynomial time mein hal ho sake; ise P se zahir karte hain. Polynomial time ka matlab hai ke input ka size barhne par hal ka waqt qabil-e-intezam raftar se (polynomial function ki tarah, jaise n, n² ya n³) barhta hai. Tractable masail ko "efficiently solvable" (efficiency se hal hone wale) samjha jata hai.

Misal: Merge Sort ya Quick Sort jaise algorithms se numbers ki list sort karna (tarteeb dena) tractable masla hai, kyun ke in algorithms ki time complexity O(n log n) hai, jahan n list mein elements ki tadaad hai.

Intractable Problems (na-qabil-e-intezam masail): yeh woh masail hain jinhein hal karne ke liye super-polynomial waqt chahiye, jo aksar input ke size ke saath exponentially (bohat tezi se, jaise 2ⁿ) barhta hai. Bare inputs ke liye inhein hal karna amalan mumkin nahi, kyun ke lagne wala waqt qabu se bahar ho jata hai.

Misal: Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP), jis mein aisa sab se chhota raasta dhoondna hota hai jo shehron ke ek group se guzar kar wapas shuru wali jagah aaye, intractable masle ki misal hai. Yeh masla NP-hard hai: shehar barhne par mumkina raaston ki tadaad factorially barhti hai, is liye bare cases ko bilkul durust (exactly) hal karna mumkin nahi rehta. Factorially ka matlab: n se 1 tak tamam whole numbers ko aapas mein multiply karna.

items: 2 shehron ke liye: 2! = 2 x 1 = 2 mumkina raaste.
3 shehron ke liye: 3! = 3 x 2 x 1 = 6 mumkina raaste.
4 shehron ke liye: 4! = 4 x 3 x 2 x 1 = 24 mumkina raaste.

blocks.text: Aap dekh sakte hain ke shehar barhane par mumkina raaston ki tadaad bohat tezi se barhti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab shehron ki har tarteeb (n!) ko ek raasta ginti hai. Agar shuru ka shehar muqarrar ho aur ulta chakkar alag na gina jaye to alag chakkar (n - 1)!/2 bante hain; magar yeh tadaad bhi factorial ki tarah hi tezi se barhti hai, is liye nateeja wahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Tractable aur intractable masail ka muwazna kijiye (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Dono solvable hain. Tractable masail ke polynomial-time algorithms hain, jin ka waqt input barhne par qabil-e-intezam rehta hai (jaise sorting, O(n log n)). Intractable masail ko super-polynomial (aksar exponential) waqt chahiye, is liye bare inputs par durust hal amalan na-mumkin ho jata hai (jaise bohat se shehron wala TSP).

items: Tractable: polynomial time (Merge Sort O(n log n)).
Intractable: super-polynomial time (TSP; raaste n! ki tarah barhte hain: 2, 6, 24, ...).
